capabilities: Visualize notes on a 3D star chart
Discuss or revise passages with Clowder AI
extras: The interface uses Chinese labels and English command names. Chat and passage revision require a separately running Clowder AI instance.
problem: Users struggle to visualize complex relationships between notes or trace the origin of specific information within a large vault.

relations.evidence: Connect a running Clowder AI instance to chat about selections

summary: A tool that visualizes note connections on a 3D star chart, traces note provenance, and allows discussion of passages using Clowder AI.
